policy: Reorganization may remove repeated boilerplate and the historical Wikipedia scaffold while preserving every topic as a dedicated section, every physical topic as an equation-bearing treatment, and at least 42 topic-specific physical mechanisms. Historical and interpretive annotations must not be assigned invented equations. Public source links must resolve to topic-bearing local equation contexts joined to exact V2.1 source-card alignments. The full book must not be replaced by a synopsis or a list of topic names.
